title: Define the workflow step contract and idempotency
context: Define the shape of a workflow step and the rules that make retries safe.

spec.summary: Define the workflow step contract and idempotency
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Every step declares inputs and outputs.
Retryable steps have an idempotency key.
A failed step is resumable or clearly terminal.
